description: Anti-rabies vaccination and wound management for individuals bitten by animals. Available at provincial and district hospitals and select RHUs.
steps: Go immediately to the nearest Animal Bite Treatment Center, RHU, or emergency room.
Present proof of Aklan residency (barangay certificate or valid ID).
Receive wound management and first dose of anti-rabies vaccine (free).
Follow up on subsequent doses as scheduled.

description: How to obtain a business permit from any of the 17 municipal governments in Aklan. Required for all businesses operating within the Province of Aklan.
steps: Step 1 — Get a Barangay Business Clearance from the Barangay Hall where your business is located.
Step 2 — Go to the Business Permit and Licensing Office (BPLO) at your Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, Aklan.
Step 3 — Fill out the Unified Application Form and submit required documents.
Step 4 — Undergo inspections (zoning, sanitary, fire safety) as required.
Step 5 — Pay the business permit fee at the Municipal Treasurer's Office.
Step 6 — Receive your Governor's Permit / Municipal Business Permit.
requirements: Lease Contract or Proof of Property Ownership

quickInfo.appointmentType: Walk-in at Provincial Capitol, Kalibo, Aklan BPLO

description: Provision of cash incentives for elderly residents reaching milestone ages of 80, 85, 90, and 95, facilitated by the National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC).
steps: Verify if the senior's name is included in the official NCSC Masterlist (January to June 2025 batch).
Secure required templates (Authorization, SPA, or Warranty & Release forms) from the OSCA Office between 8:00 AM and 5:00 PM.
Prepare the specific set of documents based on the claimant's status (Personal, Representative, or Deceased).
Proceed to the Municipal Treasury Office on the designated payout date and time.
Submit documents for verification and receive the cash incentive.
requirements: FOR PERSONAL CLAIM: 2 copies of valid ID with signature or thumbmark.
FOR REPRESENTATIVE: Authorization Letter (NCSC template), Physical ID of grantee (original + photocopy), Physical ID of claimant (original + photocopy).
FOR REPRESENTATIVE (BEDRIDDEN): Barangay Certification signed by Captain and BHW or Medical Certificate.
FOR REPRESENTATIVE (PROOF OF LIFE): Half-body photo of the grantee holding a current calendar or newspaper.

FOR DECEASED GRANTEE: Special Power of Attorney (SPA template), Warranty and Release from Liability form, Original or CTC of Death Certificate, Claimant ID with 3 signatures, and Proof of Relationship.

faqs.question: Where can I get the SPA or Authorization templates?
faqs.answer: Templates are available at the Office of the Senior Citizens Affairs (OSCA) from 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM.

faqs.question: Who is eligible for this specific payout?
faqs.answer: Seniors who are part of the qualified beneficiaries list from January to June 2025 provided by the NCSC.

quickInfo.documents: Valid IDs, SPA/Authorization, Proof of Life

description: A comprehensive list of public universities in the Province of Aklan. Aklan State University (ASU) operates five campuses across the province.
steps: Main Campus — Banga, Aklan (Banga-Libacao Highway): Focuses on agriculture, forestry, veterinary medicine, arts and sciences, and education.
Kalibo Campus — Kalibo, Aklan (Roxas Avenue Extension, Andagao): Formerly the Roxas Memorial College of Arts and Trades.
Ibajay Campus — Ibajay, Aklan: Formerly the Western Aklan Polytechnic College.
New Washington Campus — New Washington, Aklan: Formerly the Aklan National College of Fisheries.
Makato Campus — Makato, Aklan: Formerly the Northern Panay Teachers College.

faqs.question: Is tuition free at Aklan State University?
faqs.answer: Yes. Under RA 10931 (Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act), tuition is free at all State Universities and Colleges (SUCs), including all ASU campuses. Only miscellaneous fees may apply.

faqs.question: Which ASU campus should I enroll in?
faqs.answer: Choose based on your preferred program. The Main Campus in Banga offers agriculture, forestry, and veterinary medicine; Kalibo Campus offers arts, trades, and technology programs; Ibajay Campus focuses on polytechnic courses; New Washington Campus on fisheries; and Makato Campus on teacher education.

faqs.question: When does enrollment start?
faqs.answer: Enrollment typically begins in June–July for the first semester. Check the official ASU website (aklanstateuniversity.edu.ph) or each campus for exact schedules.

sources.name: Aklan State University
RA 10931 — Universal Access to Quality Tertiary Education Act
